question: Select the most appropriate answer to fill in blank 1.
solution: The correct answer is option 1) i.e. 'alleged.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Let's look at the **meaning **of the words given in the options: • **Alleged** (अभियुक्त): Claimed or accused of having done something wrong or illegal but not yet proven guilty. • **Advantaged** (सुविधाजनक): Having a position of advantage or superiority in a particular situation. • **Applied** (लागू): Put into practice or action; being used or implemented. • **Encouraged **(प्रोत्साहित): Given support, confidence, or hope to someone to do something; to inspire or motivate.​ • Let's look at the sentence: *"Mob lynching is the act of a group of people murdering a person without due process of law for an **__________** infraction."* • We can say that the implied meaning of the sentence is the act of mob lynching is committing murder by a group of people without due process of law, and the person being murdered is **not proven guilty of any crime. ** • According to the above-mentioned points, the most appropriate option to fill in the blank is "alleged" to make the sentence meaningfully correct. • Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1. ​ Complete passage:__ Mob lynching is the act of a group of people murdering a person without due process of law for an ***(1) __alleged__*** infraction. In recent years, mob lynching has become one of the hate ***(2) __crimes__*** that targets persons of a certain identity, members of a minority population, or strangers on the basis of a mere ***(3) __suspicion__***. Without obeying any principles of law, the mob takes the law into their own hands to punish the supposed*** (4) __accused__*** in the name of justice. Mob lynching is a breach of human dignity and a ***(5) __flagrant__*** violation of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights, according to Article 21 of the Indian Constitution. 1de:Td5ba,
